text: 上交所发布的最新数据显示，截至目前，沪市合计上市公司超2300家，总市值超65万亿元。其中，A股市值超千亿的头部上市公司近百家，合计市值超34.8万亿元。沪市头部公司中，科技制造企业在人工智能、集成电路、先进制造等领域加快成长，成为资本市场高质量发展的重要力量。（央视新闻）
text_en: The latest data released by the Shanghai Stock Exchange shows that, as of now, the Shanghai market has more than 2,300 listed companies in total, with a combined market value of over 65 trillion yuan. Among them, nearly 100 leading listed companies have an A-share market value of over 100 billion yuan each, with a combined market value of over 34.8 trillion yuan. Among the leading companies in the Shanghai market, technology manufacturing enterprises are accelerating their growth in fields such as artificial intelligence, integrated circuits, and advanced manufacturing, becoming an important force for the high-quality development of the capital market. (CCTV News)
